segments.comment: A Rogue darkens the first room with a cursed scroll of light, then creates four tame jackals, a peaceful gold dragon and four fog clouds. Jackals attack a fog cloud on a dark square two squares from the hero ('The jackal misses it.'), so mhitm.c (62-68) remembers an unseen monster there. In the same turn the gold dragon ends its move next to that square, and its light leaves vision_full_recalc set with no later message to spend it. allmain.c moveloop_core() (454-471) calls see_monsters() with the stale vision first, which keeps the remembered marker, and only then vision_recalc(), whose newsym() lets the marker override the cloud's gas region (display.c mon_overrides_region() 697-699) and draws the fog cloud as 'v'. Recalculating before see_monsters() draws '#' instead.
